translated_title: Arbitral Tribunal Dismisses Almost All of Vulcan's Claims Against Mexico
original_title: Tribunal arbitral desestima casi todas las reclamaciones de Vulcan contra México
author: Braulio Carbajal
meta_description: Only the 2018 closure of a property of Vulcan's CALICA subsidiary was ruled a violation, less than 1 percent of what the company had demanded from Mexico.
